headline: Apple introduces $50 usage packs for AI features in Creator Studio
summary: Apple began offering a one-time $50 usage pack extending access to AI features in Logic Pro and Creator Studio once users hit the monthly usage limit for Apple Intelligence tools.

claims.statement: Apple introduced a $50 one-time usage pack extending access to AI features once usage limits are reached.

sources.quote: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
Apple starts offering $50 extended usage packs for AI features in Creator Studio
It'll cost you to access Logic Pro's AI assistant after you reach the monthly usage limit.
With its new $50 AI usage packes, Apple is the latest company to introduce paid model for AI access.
